1. Overestimate prices during sentiment spikes (especially +1.00 or +0.67) — reduce forecast by 10–20% for high sentiment days.  
2. Underestimate prices after negative sentiment (e.g., -0.67) — add 5–15% buffer to compensate for mean reversion.  
3. Avoid long-term overconfidence in early forecast periods — cap 30d forecasts at 2.5x recent 18d average unless sentiment strongly bullish.  
4. Correct for lagged overshoots — if forecast peaks > 1.5x recent high, reduce by 20–30% to avoid overreaction.  
5. When sentiment is neutral or mixed (0.33–0.67), align forecast mean to 18d moving average — avoid extreme deviations.  
6. For 30d horizon, reduce forecast volatility if sentiment is low or negative — cap standard deviation at 0.3x recent range.
